neighbours.label: The slot where 'experience' is the predicted next word: after 'N years of', 'gained valuable', 'from personal', 'años de', 'практический' and similar lead-ins, in any language (fires whether or not the word follows)
fire: Our team brings over twenty years of experience in bridge design.
During the internship he gained hands-on experience with industrial robots.

Buscamos un cocinero con cinco años de experiencia en cocina italiana.
